name: displays
title: Displays
description: Every display with its mode and brightness: change resolution, scaling, rotation and mirroring, set an external monitor's brightness and input source, and save arrangements to switch between.
author: pal

settings.label: Brightness step
settings.description: What one press of the arrow keys, a scroll on the bar item or a `+10`-style link moves a level by, in percent. Shift with an arrow always moves 1%.

settings.label: LG input codes
settings.text: Use the alternate DDC input addressing (LG and some others)
settings.description: Most monitors take the standard VCP 60 codes for their inputs (DisplayPort 1 is 15, HDMI 1 is 17). LG's take 208 and 144 instead; turn this on if switching the input does nothing.

store.tagline: Resolution, brightness, rotation and input source for every display
features: One row per display with its resolution, refresh rate, rotation and brightness
Brightness, contrast and volume as sliders, for external monitors too (over DDC)
Switch the input source of an external monitor
Change the resolution with an easy undo, rotate, mirror or make a display the main one
Save the arrangement under a name and apply it again from the list, the bar or a link
Each tool it uses is optional; a row says what to install when one is missing

screenshots.caption: Every display with its mode and brightness; Night Shift, Sleep displays and the saved arrangements below
Enter on a monitor: brightness, contrast and volume over DDC, the input source, modes, mirroring and rotation
A control opens as a slider: the arrows move it by the step, the digits jump to 10 to 100%
Every mode the monitor takes, HiDPI first and the current one tagged; a change keeps Undo one row away
Set the brightness from the bar's text, make a display main or copy its id for a link
On the menu bar: the external monitor's brightness, a scroll on it moves it by the step
A click opens the popover: a card per display with its mode and a brightness slider
↓ moves to the next display: the arrows and the digits now set the built-in panel
On sketchybar: the sun and the level as its label

actions.title: Open
actions.description: Drills into the display: its controls, modes and arrangement.

actions.title: Set brightness
actions.description: The percent typed in the bar (or +10 / -10).

actions.title: Make main
actions.description: Moves the arrangement so this display is at (0,0).

displays.title: Displays
displays.description: Every display with its mode and brightness, the arrangement presets, Night Shift and Sleep displays; Enter drills into a display's controls.

brightness.title: Brightness
brightness.description: The external display's brightness (or the main or built-in one's, by the setting), with a slider per display in the popover, a scroll on the item moving it by the step. Hidden while only the built-in display is there, whose keys already set it, and while nothing installed can set any display: its rules, which Settings > Bar lets you turn off to keep the item.

settings.label: Display on the bar
settings.description: Whose brightness the bar item shows: the first external display (the built-in one has keys of its own), the main display, or the built-in one.

empty.tooltip: Aurora 27Q: install m1ddc to set its brightness

keys.title: Brightness down / up by the step

rules.description: Only the built-in display: its keyboard keys set it. Off, and the item stays with the built-in display's level.
Nothing installed can set any display's brightness: nothing to open a slider on.
